items.stem: Which configuration determines whether an item is tracked by batch and/or serial number in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management?

options.rationale: Correct: the tracking dimension group controls batch and serial tracking.
Costing versions hold standard/planned costs, not tracking behaviour.
Coverage groups drive master planning, not item tracking.
Wave templates drive warehouse wave processing, not item tracking.

items.explanation: Correct: the tracking dimension group controls batch and serial tracking.

items.stem: You must capture freight, insurance, and customs charges and apportion them to inbound inventory cost. Which feature do you implement?

options.rationale: Correct: landed cost tracks inbound charges and apportions them to inventory cost.
Trade agreements set prices/discounts, not inbound cost apportionment.
Quality associations trigger inspections, not cost apportionment.
Coverage groups drive planning, not landed cost.

Correct: work templates define the work created for an inbound/outbound process.

Budget models belong to finance budgeting, not warehousing.
Sales tax groups handle tax, not warehouse work.
